category_edits.rationale: Replace each SASRec feed-forward ReLU with GELU to test whether a smoother activation improves validation HR@10. Preserve widths, attention, residual paths, training settings and one model per dataset. The generated predictor imports the updated SASRec class directly.

edits.find: - Official PointWiseFeedForward: Conv1d → Dropout → ReLU → Conv1d → Dropout + residual
edits.replace: - PointWiseFeedForward: Conv1d → Dropout → GELU → Conv1d → Dropout + residual

change_summary: Use GELU in every SASRec feed-forward sublayer, consistently for training and prediction.
